Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the follow up. We saw NF-2026-331 in our queue. A couple of asks before we can schedule payment:

1) Please confirm the legal entity name and attach a W-9 (we need the EIN to push an ACH).
2) Can you provide your bank account in a structured format (bank name, routing, account last 4)?
3) We have a PO on our side (PO-4779) — can you confirm we should reference PO-4779 on the remittance?

Also — by default our AP prefers ACH for domestic vendors. We can do a virtual-card payment for immediate settlement but that requires a separate virtual-card invoice (and we typically pass a 2.5% processing fee).

If you can send the W-9 and either an ACH block or wire instructions, we’ll prioritize this for the 7/22 cut.
